purpose: Provide a deterministic high-signal C++ static-analysis gate for defects and ownership mistakes without turning subjective style heuristics or vendored code into release blockers.

toolchain.executableDiscovery: CMake resolves LLVM 23 version-suffixed executables before unversioned clang-tidy and run-clang-tidy executables. Explicit Make overrides remain supported; cached relative tool names are cleared before automatic discovery.
toolchain.runnerCompatibility: Optional run-clang-tidy presentation flags are capability-detected; unsupported options must never turn usage output into a successful no-analysis gate.
toolchain.versionPolicy: LLVM 23 is the required static-analysis baseline on ARM64 and AMD64. The configured clang-tidy must accept the complete policy through --verify-config before analysis starts; analyzer upgrades cannot silently enable a new bugprone or performance heuristic.

included: project headers reached from src translation units
scope.boundary: Shin owns findings in its C++ Core. Upstream simdjson and nlohmann sources retain their own analyzer policy and are not silently treated as Shin findings.

policy.explicitPortableCheckSet: The exact bugprone, concurrency, performance, and portability checks are declared in .clang-tidy and verified with LLVM 23 on ARM64 and AMD64.

excludedChecks.reason: Large callback and parser APIs need domain review; positional similarity alone is too noisy for a fail-closed release gate.
The reported bounded size arithmetic is already validated at ownership boundaries; blanket casts would reduce readability without adding proof.
Immutable process-lifetime tables are constructed before command dispatch; replacing them requires an architectural decision rather than analyzer-driven churn.
Internal enums are not wire or packed-storage types and measured memory does not justify fixed underlying widths.
The heuristic reports bounded command and diagnostic assembly outside measured hot paths; optimize only from benchmark evidence.
The reported const return values preserve explicit immutable ownership; removing const solely for an optional move is not a correctness gate.
Several value parameters intentionally express ownership transfer; API ownership changes require semantic review.

policy.newWarningPolicy: A new warning fails the gate. Fix the defect or add one reviewed named exclusion with a machine-readable rationale; do not use local NOLINT to hide broad debt.

releaseBoundary: Static analysis is a source-release gate. It does not alter Shin indexes, runtime output schemas, ranking, consumer adoption, or deployed runtime dependencies.
summary: Public contract for static analysis v1.
